notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43228874/a22282bcce6ed2b48cd1ec9e4950b132101d5cd9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New update on the way![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Jelooou, I'm back after several months! [/p][p][/p][p]Although I already have the complete game in my head, at times I thought about abandoning the game, but thanks to all your comments and ratings I decided to continue it![/p][p][/p][p]Very soon there will be more updates and I hope to be able to complete it this year, adding compatibility with joysticks, fixing some bugs and improving some details. notes.title: BIG CONTENT UPDATE!
notes.content:
New update!

I add:
A world map 1, to be able to repeat levels, for example to grab a musical note that was not grabbed before.
- 3 new bonus levels! They are unlocked according to how many musical notes you have grabbed. A level is unlocked: At 3 notes, at 6 notes and at 10 notes. These levels are more difficult than the rest, but they are optional.
- Along with the 3 levels, 3 new achievements! one for each extra level passed In addition to an extra achievement for talking to the cat that welcomes us into world 2.
- A glimpse of the world 2. There is still no level other than a welcome one, but it is a preview of the full game.
- More accessible assistance mode. In the escape menu you can activate the assistance mode so as not to die.
Note: With assist mode enabled, the "Speed ​​of Light" and "Tough as a Padlock" achievements cannot be achieved.
- Compatibility with some joysticks. In the pause menu with the escape key during the game, clicking the joystick activates a setting that works with some joysticks, more joysticks will be supported soon.

Thank you very much for your comments!

notes.title: ¡Lanzamiento de Tebb and the chistorbes!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=tDzQnNGuy4E;full][/previewyoutube]

---------------------------------------

¡Alguien le robo el rostro a todos! Juego de plataformas 2d lineal, muchos checkpoints, no necesitas googlear, vidas infinitas.

Tebb se encuentra con la misión de encontrar los 100 chistorbes para recuperar el rostro de todo el mundo. Controles simples: Moverse, correr y saltar, todos los desafíos giran en torno a eso. Poco a poco iras descubriendo los detalles de la historia si quieres hablar con los personajes, o ir directo al objetivo y recolectar los 100 chistorbes.

---------------------------------------

Lanzamiento de la primera versión, gratuita.
Un juego 2d de plataformas lineal con vidas infinitas, inspirado en Super Meat Boy y VVVVVV.
Se apreciaran mucho los comentarios de feedback!
